svg.title: M-03 70 cm Boom Layout - Tape Measure Satellite Yagi
svg.desc: Rev A 70 cm boom station and drill layout derived from O3/O5/O6 Rev L. Dimensions and tolerances control.
svg.text: FOR REVIEW - SOURCE O3/O5/O6 REV L
ALL X VALUES MEASURED INDEPENDENTLY FROM THE FINISHED FRONT END; DO NOT CHAIN LAYOUT.
REAR VALUES ARE NOMINAL FOR L = 30.000; ACTUAL L GOVERNS THE CROSS-CHECK.
J1 / J2: CENTER PAD AND TIE AT MARK; DO NOT DRILL EITHER BOOM.
TRANSFER LINES AT EACH RF STATION.
1. PASS MATERIAL COUPON: 70 cm TAPE ONLY.
2. MARK FRONT, REAR, BAND ID, GAIN ARROW.
5. CHECK EACH X FRONT AND X REAR USING L.
8. FIX IN V-BLOCK; DRILL 5 RF HOLES ONLY.
10. DEBURR / INSPECT; RECHECK X BOTH ENDS.
11. NO J1/J2 OR PVC FEED-NODE HOLES.
1. DIMENSIONS / TOLERANCES CONTROL. VIEW A 1:2 AT 100% PRINT.
2. FIVE 7/16 THROUGH-HOLES ONLY. COUPON APPROVAL PRECEDES FINAL DRILLING.
3. ALIGN FRONTS WITH PVC-2M; VERIFY CLOSE REFLECTORS PER M-09.
